title: Full product request — new customer
summary: A new customer, or an existing customer asking for a product Northwind does not yet run for them. Kickoff comes first. Onboarding, discovery, scope, a customer-approved proposal, and a phased estimate happen before the shared finance stage. The request does not join a sprint that is already running.

cadence.detail: Lead schedules a kickoff before build. Discovery is not boxed to the enhancement sprint. Build starts only after the customer approves the proposal, finance and security humans approve, and a kickoff record names a future sprint. Release uses the window agreed at kickoff, not the PID-ER Thursday train.

criteria: No book-of-record product for this ask, or no customer record at all
Intake card names legal name, jurisdiction, intended product, and an internal sponsor
Must not be dropped into a sprint that has already locked

stages.name: Customer onboarding
stages.sla: 5 business days. Dossier covers sponsor, jurisdiction, and whether a data-processing addendum is required. This stage does not approve the proposal.

stages.name: Scope
stages.sla: 5 business days. In scope, out of scope, and assumptions are explicit.

stages.name: Proposal
stages.sla: 5 business days to draft. Customer approval clock is 10 business days. The customer sponsor approves in #new-customer. A bot must not mark the proposal approved.

stages.name: Estimation
stages.sla: 5 business days after customer approval. This is a phased cost range, not a sprint t-shirt.

stages.name: Finance approval
stages.sla: 5 business days. Full investment memo. There is no sprint-envelope shortcut.

stages.name: Security and compliance approval
stages.humanApprover: Security officer or AI red-team lead
stages.sla: 5 business days. Security runs on every change. One human signature of kind red_team or security opens the iteration gate. A bot signature does not.

stages.name: Build
stages.sla: Starts only after kickoff names a future sprint. Builder does not merge.

stages.name: Test gate
stages.sla: Inside the build sprint named at kickoff. A failed report returns the request to build.

stages.name: Release gate
stages.sla: Release window agreed at kickoff. Human go/no-go in the request thread.
